alt.en: A violet bar chart with one tall bar stands at the center of a gray floor. In front of it, an orange line with one packet runs from a teal glass agent cube toward a teal tool tile and breaks before reaching it; a yellow warning sign stands beside the tile. A dotted violet line joins the agent to the chart.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一组紫色柱状图，其中一根柱子最高。前方一条带数据包的橙色线从青色玻璃智能体方块伸向青色工具牌，中途断开；工具牌旁立着黄色警示牌。一条紫色虚线把智能体与柱状图相连。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent's call to a tool breaks beside a warning sign while the bar chart scoring the agent still stands tall, the gap between pass rate and tool failures that Kiro describes; the diagram does not depict a tested deployment, Kiro's systems or its measurements.
caption.zh: 示意图：智能体对工具的调用在警示牌旁中断，为它打分的柱状图却依然高耸，对应 Kiro 所说的通过率与工具调用失败之间的落差；此图并不描绘经过测试的部署，也不代表 Kiro 的系统或其测量结果。
